topic: NOT wording: which pairing does not give a no-solution system
problem: Each of the following equations is paired with 4x - 6y = 18 to form a system of two linear equations. Which of the following equations does NOT result in a system with no solution?

bad.why: Rescaling every choice to compare its coefficients and constant with 4x - 6y = 18 is four proportion checks by hand, and the NOT wording makes it easy to pick a parallel line instead of the identical one.
Solving each of the four systems by substitution until it hits a contradiction or an identity is long algebra for a question the graph answers at a glance.

algebraFirst.description: Scales each choice to match the coefficients 4 and -6, compares its constant with 18, and finds that 6x - 9y = 27 scales to 4x - 6y = 18 exactly.

explanationNotes: A system has no solution when its two lines are parallel and never meet; if one equation is just the other multiplied by a number, the graphs are the same line and every point on it is a solution (infinitely many). Graph 4x - 6y = 18 with each choice: three choices run parallel beside it, while 6x - 9y = 27 lies right on top of it, so it is the one that does NOT give no solution.
